items.q: Is all dietary fat bad for you?
items.correct: No — some fat is essential; excess saturated fat is the concern.
items.misconception: Yes, all fat should be avoided.
items.why: Fats provide energy, insulation and help absorb some vitamins; balance is key.

items.q: Does protein only come from meat?
items.correct: No — pulses, dairy, eggs, soya and nuts also provide protein.
items.random_wrong: Vitamins are a source of protein.
items.why: A varied diet, including plant sources, can meet protein needs.
